title: Clearwater Home Care Daily Shift Progress Note
brief: A personal care aide's shift progress note documenting daily personal care tasks, vital signs, meal intake, and changes in client condition for an agency supervisor.

slip.document:
# Clearwater Home Care Daily Shift Progress Note
Client: Gordon Castillo
DOB: 04/12/1944
Caregiver: Wendy Gallagher, PCA
Supervisor: Lucas Ramos, RN
Date: 10/14/2026
Shift: 08:00 - 16:00

## Vital Signs
| Time | BP (mmHg) | Pulse (bpm) | Temp (°F) | Resp (/min) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 08:30 | 118/74 | 72 | 98.4 | 16 |
| 14:15 | 102/66 | 88 | 101.8 | 20 |

## Daily Living Activities and Nutrition
- Assisted client with morning shower and dressing at 09:00 with standby assist.
- Breakfast (09:45): 1 scrambled egg, 1 slice whole wheat toast, 6 oz orange juice; 100% consumed.
- Lunch (12:30): 1 cup chicken noodle soup, 4 saltine crackers, 8 oz water; 50% consumed.
- Medication reminder provided for prescribed 12:00 oral medications; client self-administered.
- Client ambulated 60 ft in hallway with rolling walker at 11:00 without incident.

## Observations and Changes in Condition
- At 14:00, client reported feeling flushed, weak, and cold, asking for an extra blanket.
- Rechecked vitals at 14:15 as shown in table above; noted new productive cough with yellow sputum.
- Client remained in bed resting comfortably with no fever noted after 14:15.
- Offered client 4 oz of warm chamomile tea at 14:45, tolerated well.

## Notifications and Handoff
- Telephoned RN supervisor Lucas Ramos to report the elevation in temperature, productive cough, and lethargy without documenting the supervisor directives received.
- Relayed client status to evening PCA at 16:00 shift handoff.

errors.quote: Client remained in bed resting comfortably with no fever noted after 14:15.
errors.explanation: The vitals table records Gordon Castillo's temperature at 14:15 as 101.8 °F, which contradicts the statement that no fever was noted.
errors.fix: Client remained in bed resting with persistent fever noted after 14:15.

errors.quote: Telephoned RN supervisor Lucas Ramos to report the elevation in temperature, productive cough, and lethargy without documenting the supervisor directives received.
errors.explanation: When reporting an acute change in condition to an RN supervisor, PCA clinical documentation must record the supervisor's instructions or action plan (such as monitoring parameters, family notification, or EMS escalation).
errors.fix: Telephoned RN supervisor Lucas Ramos to report the elevation in temperature, productive cough, and lethargy, and received directive to push fluids and notify on-call nurse if temp exceeds 102.0 °F.
